scope: Runtime template/view-model text, source asset filenames and decoded text metadata, plus source raster assets and implementation screenshot filenames/metadata/OCR. Each tool covers only the boundary below; the wordlist does not itself assert that a scan passed. Reference evidence and license/source records retain attributed source names.
sources: plan/06-decisions-and-risks.md DEC-025: forum-worker -> bbbcm-worker; forum-cli -> bbbcm-cli; sb: -> bcm:; bbbcm_ -> bcm_

scan_boundaries.scripts/a00-check.py: Template HTML, static CSS/SVG and fixtures.rs pathnames plus UTF-8 contents; all fixture pages from fixtures.json in each of the light/dark/system themes. Does not decode WOFF2 or PNG metadata and does not perform OCR. Result: docs/visual/a00/checks.json.
scan_boundaries.scripts/a00-asset-text-scan.py: All static source filenames; WOFF2 name tables, optional WOFF metadata and OpenType meta; static SVG/XML text, attributes and comments; source and implementation PNG filenames and decoded text/ICC metadata; ICO directory and all DIB frame boundaries (this container has no text metadata fields). Does not scan raster pixels. Result: docs/visual/a00/asset-text-scan.json.
scan_boundaries.scripts/a00-ocr.swift: Pixel OCR for explicitly supplied source PNGs and implementation PNGs, including generated ICO-frame PNG evidence, followed by manual image review. Does not decode embedded file metadata. Summary: docs/visual/a00/ocr-summary.json.
scan_boundaries.reference_exclusion: Reference structural evidence and attributed license/source records may contain source names; raw reference PNGs remain local for user post-processing under DEC-044. They are not counted as clean runtime or implementation assets.

matching.source_ssr_and_asset_text: NFKC + Unicode casefold, literal substring matching
matching.raster_ocr: Vision zh-Hans/en-US; case/width-insensitive literal matching after whitespace removal; OCR is auxiliary to manual review

notes: Only current plan files and this round's public observations were used; no DEC-041 output or external archive was inspected. Current plan text identifies no additional necessary historical project names. bbbcm and bbbcm-worker/bbbcm-cli are approved current code names; bcm: and bcm_ are approved current prefixes; 草莓社区/草莓论坛/草莓 are approved project terms. The historical prefix bbbcm_ is scanned without banning the approved bbbcm code name. Add any newly identified historic names before a later freeze.
